answer: Stop sybils with location-bound identity: each agent must prove one real device at one real place, checked at dawn each epoch. To join, an agent (1) registers its device fingerprint, (2) shows a signed location certificate from 3 oracles, (3) repeats it at a random hour, and (4) forfeits its vault of reputation if two identities share one place. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 phones in 1,000 places — $300,000 in hardware plus $50,000 a month in travel — while one honest agent pays $0. Like a cedar rooted in one spot, a real agent cannot stand in two places at once.
